standard.summary: 用无梯度的 unconditional 分支恢复 raw conditional 训练目标，避免对 CFG 蒸馏过的 H3 checkpoint 做常规微调时逐步「解蒸馏」。默认开启，使用常数 CFG（h3_cfg_scale，推荐 4）。
standard.effect: 每步额外跑一次无梯度 uncond 前向，把训练 target 从「模型直接输出」换算回「未蒸馏的 conditional 目标」；实际生效还要求 h3_cfg_scale > 1。旧 h3_training_adapter_path 没有 H3 runtime 消费端，现已 fail-closed；显式预融合请使用 prefuse_adapter_path。
standard.whenToUse: 所有基于蒸馏版 H3 权重（如 FL2VA pruned）的 LoRA 训练保持开启——这是维持底模无 CFG 推理能力的关键。
standard.avoidWhen: cfg_scale 设为 1 时等效关闭；对非蒸馏原始权重训练时可关闭省一次前向。

standard_en.summary: Recovers the raw conditional training target through a gradient-free unconditional branch, so ordinary finetuning of a CFG-distilled H3 checkpoint does not progressively un-distil it. On by default, using a constant CFG (h3_cfg_scale, 4 recommended).
standard_en.effect: Each step runs one extra gradient-free uncond forward and converts the training target from the model's direct output back to the undistilled conditional target; it also requires h3_cfg_scale > 1 to take effect. The old h3_training_adapter_path has no H3 runtime consumer and is now fail-closed; use prefuse_adapter_path for explicit pre-fusion.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep it on for all LoRA training built on distilled H3 weights (FL2VA pruned, say) -- it is the key to preserving the base model's CFG-free inference ability.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Setting cfg_scale to 1 is equivalent to turning it off; training on undistilled original weights can leave it off and save a forward pass.

advanced.principle: H3 发布权重内嵌了 CFG 蒸馏（模型输出 ≈ cond + s·(cond−uncond)）；naive 微调把「蒸馏后的输出」当作 conditional 目标学习，等价于每步削弱一点内嵌 guidance。CFG 保真训练用 uncond 分支按 s 反解出 raw conditional 目标，让微调作用在正确的语义上。
advanced.intervention: minimax_h3/train_step.py：preserve_cfg = h3_cfg_preservation_enabled 且 configured_cfg_scale > 1 时启用 uncond 无梯度前向与目标重构；configs_h3.py：拒绝无消费端的 h3_training_adapter_path，并校验 h3_cfg_scale 范围 [1,16]。
advanced.expectedImpact: 长训后底模的 few-step/无 CFG 生成能力保持完好；每步多一次无梯度前向，吞吐下降约与前向占比成比例。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要缓存/编码 unconditional 文本张量（h3_cache_text_encoder_outputs 默认包含）；cfg_scale 与推理端习惯不匹配时保真效果打折。
advanced.codePath: minimax_h3/train_step.py：preserve_cfg 分支；configs_h3.py：h3_training_adapter_path fail-closed 校验

advanced_en.principle: H3's released weights embed CFG distillation (model output ≈ cond + s·(cond−uncond)); naive fine-tuning learns the "distilled output" as the conditional target, effectively weakening the embedded guidance a little every step. CFG-faithful training uses the uncond branch to back-solve the raw conditional target with s, so fine-tuning acts on the correct semantics.
advanced_en.intervention: minimax_h3/train_step.py: preserve_cfg activates when h3_cfg_preservation_enabled and configured_cfg_scale > 1, running a no-grad uncond forward and target reconstruction; configs_h3.py: rejects h3_training_adapter_path with no consumer and validates h3_cfg_scale in [1,16].
advanced_en.expectedImpact: After long runs the base model's few-step / no-CFG generation stays intact; one extra no-grad forward per step, with throughput dropping roughly in proportion to that forward's share.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Requires caching/encoding the unconditional text tensor (h3_cache_text_encoder_outputs includes it by default); a cfg_scale mismatched with inference habits dilutes the fidelity benefit.
advanced_en.codePath: minimax_h3/train_step.py: preserve_cfg branch; configs_h3.py: fail-closed validation of h3_training_adapter_path
